title: the initials card has its heading again
why: When each player got a set of initials, the heading line of the card was rewritten to say whose turn it is, but the statement that adds the heading to the card was left inside the comment after it. Since then the card has shown the three letters and the hint and nothing else, so a two player run was not told whether player 1 or player 2 was typing, and a one player run was not told what the letters were for.
now: The initials card shows its heading again: player 1 then player 2 enter initials in a two player run, and top 10 tonight, enter initials in a one player run.
